notes.title: Update 1.2: Improved graphics..
notes.content:
Hi friends,

From the community you have asked us to improve the graphic section of the game. We listened to you and got to work on version 1.2 of Kate Don't Wait, which includes improved graphics and animations.

Changes:

-Improved graphics: especially in some scenes on the Island.
-New sprites of the zombie and the parrot.
-More fluid and colorful animations.

We leave you a new screenshot: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41036350/dab4839619ab2d959a2708281b0be66fbcd6f5f1.png[/img]

We hope you like it.

notes.title: Update 1.1: English translation improved
notes.content:
Hi,

Thanks to the Steam mentors encouraging us (specials thanks to Мизантроп, Kilroy and Chopper Dave) to improve the English translation, we have gotten into it and updated the translation into the mentioned language.

If you have any more suggestions to improve the game, please let us know; We will try to improve within our means.

Thanks !!

notes.title: Adding alternate ending
notes.content:
Hello friends,

We would like to tell you that the development of Kate Don’t Wait is continuing; At the beginning, we had planned to include two endings: one in which you win Kate's heart while making the revolution, and another in which something completely different happens to you.

However, we know that many lovers of visual novels like to have an alternate ending, so we've gotten to work on it and are implementing an alternate ending.

This one will remain hidden though… until you've reached the good end of the reboot story.

We hope you like the alternate ending !!!

notes.title: Release date announced
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Release date announced.[/b]
[/list]

The buts are coming for you, Jack: they want to infect you so that you serve the Accumulator as if you were a carcass nod, a piece of the cannibal machine; However, you have met Kate and she has been involved in the rebooters movement ...

[b]Next November 3 (November 4 for countries with GMT + 2 hours like Spain) you will be able to enjoy Kate Don't Wait[/b], the visual novel that deals with love as a metaphor for utopia, at a price of 3 , 99 $ / £ .

During the launch you can enjoy a 10% discount; Take advantage of this offer, which will last until November 10.

[list]
[*] [b]You will be able to continue the game where you left off.[/b]
[/list]

If you want to see how the game feels, what emotions it transmits and how it is set, you can try the demo. In the full version of the game, you will be able to continue the game where you left off through the menu.

Kate is waiting for you on November 3, are you going to miss the appointment?

notes.title: New Gameplay + demo announcement
notes.content:
Kate is waiting for you!

She demands your love!

You will be able to respond in a very short time...

Before the Steam Next Fest begins, you can try the demo version of Kate Don’t Wait, the visual novel in which you must conquer the heart of your beloved while walking towards a new world. Will you be able to do it or will the buts catch you?

Here we leave a video with the gameplay of the initial part of the demo.
